vb_textbox.text: It is generally higher on the left I have found but it is very random sometimes. I find that when one colour group is lower then it stays low for a while so switch to the other colour, i.e. purple is a good choice and grey. It's difficult to get it right every time and this is a game of chance and you have to be very quick to make the decision, otherwise you will lose the points. It's best to go with the colour that is giving you higher points consistently.
